subject: *: move dup key error handling to `errctx` (#50239)
summary: Adds `errctx.ErrGroupDupKey` (mapping `errno.ErrDupEntry`) and replaces `StatementContext.DupKeyAsWarning` with errctx-level handling across insert/update/load-data paths. Reviewed changed executor/sessionctx/table call sites for IGNORE semantics, warning behavior, and pessimistic txn lazy-check gating; no remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or consistency issues found in this commit.
